description: Expose safe planner provider evidence through the controller API and embedded UI, add focused reporting tests, and perform a non-destructive local Ollama planning smoke check with explicit evidence limits.
steps: In controller/main.py, keep planner_provider_info limited to provider label, model, and a safe endpoint representation; expose it from /planner-provider and include the same evidence in /plan responses and queued job data without returning secrets.

In the PHONE_UI embedded markup and script, keep the provider status visible and render the exact active local label Ollama / local-only with its local endpoint; retain OpenAI as a visibly distinct OpenAI option and show a safe configuration error when provider resolution fails.

In controller/test_planner_provider.py, add or tighten unittest coverage for accepted/rejected endpoint forms, safe provider reporting, plan/provider payload behavior where practical, cloud-environment removal, and OpenAI separation. Do not test through or alter generated-app.

If a local Ollama server and configured model are available, run a direct planning-only request with cloud variables unset, capture the safe provider label/endpoint and returned plan text, and observe active TCP connections with lsof or nettop during the request when practical. Record that this proves application-level endpoint selection/environment scrubbing only, not that other OS processes made no network connections.
acceptance_criteria: The controller UI visibly says Ollama / local-only when Ollama is active and shows only the safe local endpoint, never a credential.
The planner provider API/plan response reports the active provider and endpoint safely, and OpenAI mode reports as OpenAI rather than local-only.
Focused tests pass for endpoint enforcement, provider reporting, and no-cloud subprocess environment behavior.
The local smoke evidence identifies the provider and endpoint and clearly distinguishes application-level enforcement from OS-level network proof.
verification: If Ollama is running locally: execute the README planning-only smoke pattern from the repository root with OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_BASE unset, and record the printed provider/endpoint evidence and successful local response; observe lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:ESTABLISHED or nettop during the request when practical.
findings: Iteration 2 review fixes made the README smoke reproducible: it disables .env loading for the smoke process, unsets the intended cloud-provider credential/base variables, prints planner_provider_info(provider), and states the expected safe evidence. The exact smoke command ran from /Users/antoniociolino/voice-developer and printed PROVIDER_EVIDENCE {'name': 'ollama', 'label': 'Ollama / local-only', 'model': 'qwen2.5:7b', 'endpoint': 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1'} followed by Ollama planning-only smoke passed. The focused suite passed with 15 tests, compilation passed, and the planner diff check passed. Earlier loopback smoke lsof evidence showed the planner process connected only to 127.0.0.1:11434; the current smoke confirms the documented provider/endpoint output but does not claim a new OS-level connection audit. These observations prove application-level planner endpoint selection and Aider environment scrubbing only. They do not prove that unrelated operating-system processes made no network connections, and they do not provide a firewall/router guarantee. No cloud model was requested, no OS network/firewall setting was changed, and unrelated generated-app/package.json and generated-app/src/App.jsx changes remain preserved.
